corrections: Disabled trigger collapse now returns focus to its named section instead of losing focus to the document. Temporary focus attributes restore on blur/disconnection.
Duplicate and empty Accordion keys disable ambiguous interaction and report a diagnostic.
OwnedContent forwards explicit Lit RootPart disconnect/reconnect, and lazy content waits for its actual owner.
--acme-accent was undefined: authored focus styles now use --ds-focus-color. Three-engine computed-style tests fail before and pass after the correction.
The first expanded fixture omitted Tabs dependencies; complete explicit class registration fixes the fixture, not component code.
limits: React and scoped-registry controlled content remain M22; this slice does not claim their acceptance.
Actual Safari, OS input and assistive technology checks remain M22/M26.
M15 still requires Steps/Timeline, Toolbar/App Bar/Breadcrumbs and Command Menu; the public Dialog dependency comes forward from M17.
CI integration of native browser acceptance remains M25.
